lines.en: label day218:
scene noonsky
It’s just before nightfall and I find myself headed to the mall with Ami and Maya.
lines.zh: 天刚要黑，我便和 Ami、Maya 一起前往商场。

lines.en: It isn’t often that the three of us do anything without Ayane, so the air feels a little stranger than normal.
lines.zh: 我们三个不带 Ayane 单独行动并不常见，所以气氛比平时要怪一些。

lines.en: Granted, it isn’t often that Maya agrees to a plan with me involved in any form, so the entire foundation of this trip is a little out of the ordinary.
lines.zh: 话说回来，Maya 会同意任何有我参与的计划，本身就是件稀奇事，所以这趟行程从根子上就不太寻常。

lines.en: : Sensei! What’s my spending limit for today?!
lines.zh: : Sensei！我今天的花费上限是多少？！

lines.en: I reach into my pocket and pull out...absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: 我把手伸进口袋，掏出来的是……什么都没有。

lines.en: I have no cash.
lines.zh: 我身上没有现金。

lines.en: : Zero Yen.
lines.zh: : 零日元。

lines.en: : Zero Yen?!
lines.zh: : 零日元？！

lines.en: : That’s even less than when you only gave me 1,000!
lines.zh: : 这比您只给我 1000 日元的时候还少！

lines.en: : Yes, that is how numbers work.
lines.zh: : 对，数字就是这么运作的。

lines.en: : Just give me your credit card. I checked your bank info online and it says you’re nowhere near your spending limit.
lines.zh: : 把您的信用卡给我就行了。我上网查过您的银行信息，上面说您离透支额度还远着呢。

lines.en: : How did you access my bank information?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么查到我的银行信息的？

lines.en: : Easy. I know your email from the[school] messageboard and your password for the banking website was {i}Boobies123{/i}.
lines.zh: : 简单。我从[school]留言板上知道了您的邮箱，而您银行网站的密码是 {i}Boobies123{/i}。

lines.en: : I am a simple man. Don’t judge.
lines.zh: : 我就是个简单的人。别评判我。

lines.en: : You’re disgusting...
lines.zh: : 您真恶心……

lines.en: scene black
Now, you’re probably wondering why I would have made something as childish as “Boobies123” my password.
lines.zh: 现在，你大概在想，我为什么会把「Boobies123」这么幼稚的东西设成密码。

lines.en: And I have a perfectly reasonable explanation for that.
lines.zh: 对此，我有一个完全合理的解释。

lines.en: When I first woke up in Kumon-mi, I had a remarkably difficult time trying to access important things like my email account and bank information.
lines.zh: 我刚在 Kumon-mi 醒来的时候，想登录邮箱和银行信息这类重要的东西，特别费劲。

lines.en: So, after some hacker-level account recovery troubleshooting (Which really just involved answering simple questions like “What is your [niece]’s name?”) I was able to get back into everything.
lines.zh: 于是，在经过一番黑客级别的账号找回排查之后（其实就是回答「你的[niece]叫什么名字？」之类的简单问题），我总算把所有东西都找了回来。

lines.en: Then, being fed up with Internet stuff and just wanting to end the process, I changed all of my passwords to the first thing that came to mind.
lines.zh: 然后，我受够了这些网络上的破事，只想赶紧结束整个流程，就把所有密码都改成了我脑子里冒出来的第一个东西。

lines.en: Hence- “Boobies123.”
lines.zh: 于是就有了——「Boobies123」。

lines.en: Shut up. At least I’m open about my interests.
lines.zh: 闭嘴。至少我对自己的爱好很坦诚。

lines.en: scene green1
: Shopping trip...start!
lines.zh: : 购物之旅……开始！

lines.en: : Hooray for spending money I don’t have.
lines.zh: : 花我没有的钱，万岁。

lines.en: scene green2
: Thanks for letting me borrow your credit card, Sensei. I’ll be sure to make it up to you when I get rich off of becoming a super-popular maid.
lines.zh: : 谢谢您把信用卡借给我，Sensei。等我靠当超人气女仆发了财，一定会报答您的。

lines.en: : I still can’t believe you are stooping to Uta’s level just for some extra spending money.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信，你为了多挣点零花钱，居然堕落到 Uta 那个级别。

lines.en: : Don’t listen to Maya. She’s just jealous because she needs to live off of her savings and is too lazy to get a job and make any money of her own.
lines.zh: : 别听 Maya 的。她只是嫉妒罢了，因为她得靠存款过日子，又懒得去找工作自己挣钱。

lines.en: : How is your savings account enough to live off of at your age?
lines.zh: : 你这个年纪，存款怎么够你生活？

lines.en: scene green3
: I’m good at rationing my money.
lines.zh: : 我很会精打细算。

lines.en: : My main strategy is choosing quantity over quality and eating large amounts of mediocre food that will last me two or three days at a time in the form of leftovers.
lines.zh: : 我的主要策略是重数量不重质量，一次买一大堆一般的食物，靠剩菜吃上两三天。

lines.en: : Well, that’s not a {i}bad{/i} idea...but it doesn’t sound very fulfilling.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这主意不算{i}坏{/i}……不过听起来不太有满足感。

lines.en: : We can’t all have a girl who cooks and cleans for us every morning.
lines.zh: : 又不是谁都能有个每天早晨给自己做饭打扫的女孩。

lines.en: : Sensei, can Maya move in so she can eat with us and won’t have to ration her savings anymore?
lines.zh: : Sensei，能让 Maya 搬过来住吗？这样她就能和我们一起吃饭，也不用再算计她的存款了。

lines.en: : Are you asking me to support Maya as if she were my child?
lines.zh: : 你这是在要求我像养孩子一样养 Maya？

lines.en: : Ew. Don’t even joke about that.
lines.zh: : 恶。这种玩笑都别开。

lines.en: : Is that a yes?
lines.zh: : 那就是答应了？

lines.en: : What? No. Not even close.
lines.zh: : 什么？不。差得远了。

lines.en: : For once, I am actually thankful for how horrible of a person you are.
lines.zh: : 我还是头一回，真心感谢您是个这么糟糕的人。

lines.en: : You’re welcome, Maya.
lines.zh: : 不客气，Maya。

lines.en: scene green4
: Oh well. Can’t say I didn’t expect you to say that.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我可以说我早就料到您会这么说了。

lines.en: Ami and Maya begin to look around the mall, probably figuring out which stores they want to head to first.
lines.zh: Ami 和 Maya 开始在商场里四处张望，大概是在盘算先去哪家店。

lines.en: Just like they said yesterday, the mall is actually a bit more crowded than normal.
lines.zh: 正如她们昨天所说，商场确实比平时要挤一些。

lines.en: I guess even the lack of men around doesn’t make much of a dent in people shopping for those who are important to them.
lines.zh: 我想，就算周围男人少得可怜，也没怎么影响到大家为重要的人买东西的热情。

lines.en: It’s just weird to me that there are so many people around here that actually {i}have{/i} someone important to them in the first place.
lines.zh: 只是我觉得奇怪，这一带居然有这么多人，真的{i}拥有{/i}对自己而言重要的人。

lines.en: It’s kind of a bitch finding companionship in general, let alone companionship with someone of the same sex.
lines.zh: 找个伴本来就够操蛋的了，更别说找个同性的伴。

lines.en: It’s just one of several reasons I surround myself with cute girls instead of other mysterious, glasses-wearing guys.
lines.zh: 这也只是我把自己包围在可爱女孩之中、而不是其他戴眼镜的神秘男人之中的几个理由之一。

lines.en: Why devote yourself to anything you wouldn’t also have sex with?
lines.zh: 为什么要为自己不会想上床的东西投入精力？

lines.en: That’s just how I look at it.
lines.zh: 我就是这么看的。

lines.en: scene green5
: Huh...
: Kinda weird they don’t have any Christmas decorations up yet.
lines.zh: : 他们还没挂上圣诞装饰，有点奇怪。

lines.en: : The mall normally has lights up around this time of year. Wonder if they’re just...too busy to hang ‘em up or something?
lines.zh: : 商场往年这个时候早就挂上灯了。不知道是不是……太忙了没顾上挂之类的？

lines.en: : Don’t see how it makes much of a difference.
lines.zh: : 我看不出这有多大区别。

lines.en: : Don’t say that to Ayane. She’ll hit you. That girl’s a holiday-aholic.
lines.zh: : 这话可别对 Ayane 说。她会揍您的。那丫头是个节日狂。

lines.en: : That’s not even a thing.
lines.zh: : 「节日狂」这词根本就不存在。

lines.en: scene green6
: So, what’s {i}your{/i} gameplan, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那么，Sensei，{i}您的{/i}计划是什么？

lines.en: : Are you gonna come with us into all of the stores and watch us try on cute winter stuff? Or are you going to go abduct another little girl and force her to wear a dog mask?
lines.zh: : 您是打算跟我们一起进每一家店，看我们试可爱的冬装？还是打算再去拐一个小女孩，逼她戴上狗面具？

lines.en: : She had an immuno-deficiency disorder...
lines.zh: : 她有免疫缺陷疾病……

lines.en: : ...And that’s supposed to explain the dog mask?
lines.zh: : ……这就能解释狗面具了？

lines.en: scene green7
: Poor girl never even had a chance. She’s in a better place now.
lines.zh: : 那可怜的女孩一点机会都没有。她现在去了一个更好的地方。

lines.en: : She’s still alive...
lines.zh: : 她还活着……

lines.en: : Only because Ami and I showed up. Who knows where you would have taken her if we hadn’t?
lines.zh: : 那只是因为我和 Ami 及时出现。要是我们没来，谁知道您会把她带到哪儿去？

lines.en: : Yup-yup! If you’re into dog masks, you know I wouldn’t mind-
lines.zh: : 对对！如果您好狗面具这一口，您知道的，我也不介意——

lines.en: : I’m going to stop you right there just to clarify that I am very much not {i}into{/i} dog masks.
lines.zh: : 我得打断你一下，澄清一下：我一点都不好{i}狗面具{/i}这一口。

lines.en: : Please preserve your mostly-innocent image and don’t offer to accommodate strange fetishes like that.
lines.zh: : 请保住你那大体上还算纯洁的形象，别主动去迎合那种奇怪的癖好。

lines.en: : Okay! I’m already kind of a fetish character in the first place, so I can see how doing more stuff like that might be over the top.
lines.zh: : 好嘛！我本来就算是个癖好型角色，所以我明白再做那种事大概就过头了。

lines.en: scene green8
: Are you really just going to openly admit that?
lines.zh: : 你还真就这么公开承认了？

lines.en: : Admit what? I haven’t said anything.
lines.zh: : 承认什么？我什么都没说啊。

lines.en: : Please, for the love of the god I don’t believe in, do not turn into your [uncle].
lines.zh: : 求你了，看在我并不相信的那个神的分上，别变成你[uncle]那样。

lines.en: : Maya, do you need to borrow my credit card as well?
lines.zh: : Maya，你也要借我的信用卡吗？

lines.en: scene green9
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Is that an actual offer or are you actually insensitive enough to joke about a girl’s financial situation?
lines.zh: : 这是认真的提议，还是说您真的迟钝到会拿一个女孩的经济状况开玩笑？

lines.en: : It’s an actual offer.
lines.zh: : 是认真的提议。

lines.en: : If Ami’s going to go off and buy stuff for herself, I don’t see the harm in you getting a thing or two as well.
lines.zh: : 既然 Ami 要去给自己买东西，我也不觉得让你买一两件有什么坏处。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well uhh, thanks?
lines.zh: : 那，呃，谢谢？

lines.en: : I’m okay, though. I’m not like, poor or anything. It’s fine as long as I only buy new clothes every few seasons.
lines.zh: : 不过我没事。我又不是，呃，穷什么的。只要我每个季度才买一次新衣服，就没问题。

lines.en: : There you have it, Sensei. Does this mean I can spend extra since Maya won’t be using your card?
lines.zh: : 您听到了吧，Sensei。那是不是意味着我可以在 Maya 不用的份上多花点？

lines.en: : Not at all. Please try to stay under 1,000 Yen total.
lines.zh: : 一点都不行。请尽量把总额控制在 1000 日元以内。

lines.en: scene green10
: I hate you and your stupid 1,000 Yen limit! I’m gonna go spend a billion Yen on stuff I don’t even need now!
lines.zh: : 我恨您和您那该死的 1000 日元上限！我现在就要去花十亿日元买一堆我根本不需要的东西！

lines.en: : Come on, Maya!
lines.zh: : 走了，Maya！

lines.en: scene green11
Ami and Maya storm off and I’m suddenly left on my own without ever even having the chance to tell them I planned on coming.
lines.zh: Ami 和 Maya 气冲冲地走了，我突然就落了单，连告诉她们我本来打算一起走的机会都没有。

lines.en: It is what it is, though. I should probably buy some winter clothes myself if it’s actually going to start getting cold around here.
lines.zh: 不过事已至此。如果这里真要开始变冷，我大概也该给自己买点冬装了。

lines.en: scene black
It’s been almost scorching every day since I was reincarnated.
lines.zh: 自从我转生以来，几乎每天都热得要命。

lines.en: For a while, I may have even thought that things were just going to stay that way forever.
lines.zh: 有那么一阵，我甚至觉得事情大概会永远这样下去。

lines.en: But I guess a little change is good every now and then.
lines.zh: 不过我想，偶尔有点变化也好。

lines.en: scene green12
I wind up instinctively heading over to the store Chika works at to see if she’s in today.
lines.zh: 我本能地走向 Chika 打工的那家店，想看看她今天在不在。

lines.en: Of course, it’s a Friday and[school] only ended a few hours ago, so she’s nowhere to be found.
lines.zh: 当然，今天是周五，[school]才放学几个小时，所以她根本不在。

lines.en: It isn’t long before an employee I’ve never seen comes over to me and asks if I need help with anything.
lines.zh: 没过多久，一个我从没见过的店员走了过来，问我需不需要帮忙。

lines.en: : Good afternoon, Sir. Are you looking for anything in particular today?
lines.zh: : 下午好，先生。您今天有什么特别想找的吗？

lines.en: : Yes, actually. How about a tan blonde with a ponytail and an affinity for pink?
lines.zh: : 有，还真有。古铜色皮肤、金色头发、扎着马尾、还特别喜欢粉色的那种怎么样？

lines.en: : Ponytail?...
: Is this...a prank?
lines.zh: : 这是……恶作剧？

lines.en: : Do I need to call security?
lines.zh: : 需要我叫保安吗？

lines.en: : No...I was just joking.
lines.zh: : 不……我只是开个玩笑。

lines.en: : Can you point me to where you keep all of your winter clothing? I’m thinking it’s time for a change in my life.
lines.zh: : 你能指一下你们的冬季服装放在哪儿吗？我在想，是时候给自己的生活来点改变了。

lines.en: : I’d love to!
lines.zh: : 我很乐意！

lines.en: : Unfortunately...most of our winter stock has yet to arrive.
lines.zh: : 可惜……我们的冬季货品大部分还没到。

lines.en: : All we have for men are slightly thicker shirts and-
lines.zh: : 男装目前只有稍微厚一点的衬衫，还有——

lines.en: : Good enough for me.
lines.zh: : 对我来说够了。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : I’m not really that into fashion anyway and that sounds cheaper than anything else I’d find here.
lines.zh: : 反正我也不怎么讲究穿搭，而且这听起来比我在这里能找到的其他东西都便宜。

lines.en: : Oh...Well, okay then. Right this way, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 哦……那好吧。请跟我来。

lines.en: scene black
The employee leads me to a section composed entirely of blank T-shirts.
lines.zh: 店员把我领到一个全是纯色 T 恤的区域。

lines.en: Really wanting to mix things up, I go with grey {i}and{/i} white instead of just white and prepare to shock my students when they see me in my new casual attire.
lines.zh: 我真的很想换换风格，所以选了灰色{i}和{/i}白色，而不只是白色，准备等学生们看到我这身新休闲装时被吓一跳。

lines.en: scene green13
: Oh?
I stop myself on the way out of the store after purchasing a few new shirts and find two green scarves wrapped neatly around a pair of mannequins.
lines.zh: 买了几件新衬衫，在出店的路上我停下了脚步，看到两个人偶脖子上整齐地围着两条绿色围巾。

lines.en: : I feel compelled to buy these for some reason.
lines.zh: : 不知为什么，我总觉得非买下来不可。

lines.en: : Looking for a gift now, Sir?
lines.zh: : 先生，现在是要挑礼物了吗？

lines.en: The same employee from before sneaks up behind me and begins trying to sell me the scarves.
lines.zh: 刚才那位店员悄悄绕到我身后，开始向我推销起那两条围巾。

lines.en: I am weak to upselling.
lines.zh: 我最受不了追加推销了。

lines.en: This is going to end poorly.
lines.zh: 这事不会有好结果的。

lines.en: : These actually just came in this morning.
lines.zh: : 这些其实是今天早上刚到的。

lines.en: : It was so strange as well. We never ordered anything like these.
lines.zh: : 而且特别奇怪。我们根本没订过这种东西。

lines.en: : But it’s not like I was about to just let them go to waste so...voila.
lines.zh: : 不过我也不能就这么放着浪费掉，所以……您瞧。

lines.en: : So you’re selling things you never even ordered? How do you know how they should be priced?
lines.zh: : 所以你们在卖根本没订过的货？那你怎么知道该定什么价？

lines.en: : Oh, I have no idea. I just guessed.
lines.zh: : 哦，我也不知道。我就随便猜的。

lines.en: : If you act now, I’ll let you have both for just 4,000 Yen. My regional manager is on the way here anyway so I was actually just about to take them down and hide them.
lines.zh: : 如果您现在就买，两条一起只要 4000 日元。反正我的区域经理正往这边来，我正准备把它们摘下来藏起来呢。

lines.en: : So I’m basically the only chance you have of selling these?
lines.zh: : 所以基本上，我是你唯一能把它们卖出去的机会？

lines.en: : You are! And-
lines.zh: : 没错！而且——

lines.en: : I’ll give you 2,000 Yen.
lines.zh: : 我出 2000 日元。

lines.en: : ...That’s half of the asking price.
lines.zh: : ……那是要价的一半。

lines.en: : There is no asking price. This isn't even an item you're supposed to carry.
lines.zh: : 根本就没有什么要价。这甚至都不是你们该卖的东西。

lines.en: : 2,000 Yen or I walk.
lines.zh: : 2000 日元，不然我走人。

lines.en: : Fine...I guess this is my fault for revealing my secrets to you in the first place.
lines.zh: : 好吧……说到底也是我自己的错，一开始就不该把秘密告诉您。

lines.en: : Don’t beat yourself up over it. I rarely ever buy things for other people to begin with.
lines.zh: : 别太自责。我本来就不怎么给别人买东西。

lines.en: : This is a major victory for you.
lines.zh: : 这对你来说已经是一场大胜了。

lines.en: : Sure...Right this way, Sir.
lines.zh: : 是吗……那这边请，先生。

lines.en: scene black
Once again, I find myself pulling out my wallet and having to use the same backup credit card I used when purchasing my shirts due to Ami having the normal one.
lines.zh: 我再一次掏出钱包，因为常用的那张卡在 Ami 手里，只能用买衬衫时用过的那张备用信用卡。

lines.en: Then, before I know it, I’m back in the hallway carrying multiple bags, hoping to find the two girls I came here with.
lines.zh: 然后不知不觉，我就拎着好几个袋子回到了走廊上，希望能找到跟我一起来这儿的两个女孩。

lines.en: : Oh! Sensei!
lines.zh: : 哦！Sensei！

lines.en: scene green14
Ami comes running over to me, dropping a few bags of clothes she bought for herself at her feet.
lines.zh: Ami 朝我跑了过来，把她给自己买的几袋衣服往脚边一扔。

lines.en: Maya shows up seconds later, but with only one bag as opposed to Ami’s three.
lines.zh: Maya 几秒后也出现了，不过只有一个袋子，而 Ami 有三个。

lines.en: At least I know she’d be more financially responsible if I {i}were{/i} to ever adopt her.
lines.zh: 至少我知道，要是我{i}真{/i}收养她，她在花钱上会比我更靠谱。

lines.en: : Heya! We’re basically done here.
lines.zh: : 嘿呀！我们这边基本搞定啦。

lines.en: : We’ve just gotta stop by a few other stores to get some stuff like boots and gloves and-
lines.zh: : 我们还得再去几家店买点靴子手套之类的——

lines.en: scene green15
: Hey, whatcha got there?
lines.zh: : 嘿，您手里拿的是什么？

lines.en: : Did you actually buy yourself something for once?
lines.zh: : 您这次真的给自己买东西了？

lines.en: : I did. I am now prepared for the cold.
lines.zh: : 买了。我现在已经为寒冷做好准备了。

lines.en: : Hooray. One less thing for me to worry about.
lines.zh: : 万岁。我又少一件要操心的事。

lines.en: : ...And I {i}also{/i} got Maya here a present.
lines.zh: : ……而且我{i}还{/i}给这里的 Maya 买了件礼物。

lines.en: scene green16
: Wait, for real?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : I just felt like being nice.
lines.zh: : 我只是想表现得善良一点。

lines.en: : Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 您确定？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have bought it if I wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 要不是确定的话，我就不会买了。

lines.en: : Well...thank you.
lines.zh: : 那……谢谢您。

lines.en: : Can I see what it is?
lines.zh: : 我能看看是什么吗？

lines.en: : Sure. Go right ahead.
lines.zh: : 当然。看吧。

lines.en: scene green17
I hand Maya a bright green bag and she walks several steps away to check what’s inside.
lines.zh: 我把一个亮绿色的袋子递给 Maya，她走出好几步远去看里面是什么。

lines.en: Obviously, it’s nothing to be excited about, so I’m sure she’ll be back to her typical, unwavering self in a few seconds.
lines.zh: 显然这没什么好激动的，所以我敢说她几秒之后就会回到那个一贯不为所动的自己。

lines.en: : Hey! What’s the big idea, mister?!
lines.zh: : 嘿！你这是什么意思啊，先生？！

lines.en: : How come Maya gets a present and I don’t?!
lines.zh: : 凭什么 Maya 有礼物我没有？！

lines.en: : Oh, did I forget to say I got you one as well?
lines.zh: : 哦，我是不是忘了说我也给你买了一份？

lines.en: : Here.
scene green18
: Ah! Present! What is it?! What is it?!
lines.zh: : 啊！礼物！是什么？！是什么？！

lines.en: Ami quickly snatches the bag out of my hands and looks inside of it.
lines.zh: Ami 一把从我手里抢过袋子，往里面看去。

lines.en: : It’s just a scarf. I’m not sure if you bought one yet so, if you did, feel free to take this one ba-
lines.zh: : 只是一条围巾。我不确定你有没有买过，要是买过了，尽管把这条拿去退——

lines.en: : Actually, never mind. I don’t think this is returnable.
lines.zh: : 算了，当我没说。我觉得这东西退不了。

lines.en: : It’s perfect! All the stuff I bought earlier was green, too!
lines.zh: : 太完美了！我之前买的东西也都是绿色的！

lines.en: : Maya’s is just a little bit brighter.
lines.zh: : Maya 那条的颜色稍微亮一点。

lines.en: : I know you two planned on matching, so I hope this much is okay.
lines.zh: : 我知道你们俩打算穿成一套，所以希望这样没问题。

lines.en: : It’s super okay! I love it!
lines.zh: : 完全没问题！我太喜欢了！

lines.en: scene green19
: Maya, let me see-
lines.zh: : Maya，让我看看——

lines.en: scene green20
: Huh?
: What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : Maya? Are you okay?
lines.zh: : Maya？你没事吧？

lines.en: scene green21
: Yeah, I figured she'd react that way. You can just have hers as well, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我猜她会是这个反应。那她那份也给你好了。

lines.en: : Does she really hate it that much?
lines.zh: : 她真的那么讨厌吗？

lines.en: : Maya, you should at least thank Sensei for going out of his way to get you a present.
lines.zh: : Maya，你至少该谢谢 Sensei 特地给你买了礼物。

lines.en: : Maybe she’s not feeling okay?
lines.zh: : 也许她是不太舒服？

lines.en: scene green22
: This...
: This is a joke...right?
lines.zh: : 这是开玩笑……对吧？

lines.en: : Maya?
lines.zh: : Maya？

lines.en: : Yeah. A joke. It’s a joke...
lines.zh: : 对。是个玩笑。就是个玩笑……

lines.en: scene green23
: Hahah...hahahah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Hahahahah! HAHAHAHHAHAH!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈！哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Okay, now she's just being dramatic.
lines.zh: : 好了，她现在纯粹是在演。

lines.en: scene green24
: Haha...hah...
: I really do...
lines.zh: : 我真的……

lines.en: : Have the worst luck in the world...
lines.zh: : 是全世界运气最差的人……

lines.en: scene black
Ami and I stand in silence as Maya slowly but surely regains her composure and brings herself back to her feet.
lines.zh: 我和 Ami 沉默地站着，Maya 慢慢地、一步一步重新镇定下来，自己站了起来。

lines.en: She picks up the bag and holds it tightly against her chest for a few seconds.
lines.zh: 她拿起袋子，紧紧抱在胸前好几秒。

lines.en: She breathes in and shakes her head as if to wash away any semblance of uneasiness that crept onto her face over the last several minutes.
lines.zh: 她深吸一口气，摇了摇头，像是想把这几分钟里爬上脸庞的那一丝不安洗掉。

lines.en: The bell around her neck jingles as she does so.
lines.zh: 她这么做时，脖子上的铃铛叮当作响。

lines.en: And then-
lines.zh: 然后——

lines.en: She lowers her arms and goes back to being a normal [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: 她放下手臂，重新变回一个普通的 [teenage]女孩。

lines.en: scene green25
: Ahem.
lines.zh: : 咳咳。

lines.en: : Thank you very much for the gift.
lines.zh: : 非常感谢您的礼物。

lines.en: : It was very kind of you.
lines.zh: : 您真是太好了。

lines.en: : The heck? Are we just pretending none of that ever happened?
lines.zh: : 搞什么？我们是要假装刚才什么都没发生过吗？

lines.en: scene green26
: Nothing {i}did{/i} happen.
lines.zh: : 什么都{i}没发生过{/i}。

lines.en: : I received a bag, I opened the bag, and immediately thanked Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我收到一个袋子，打开袋子，然后立刻向 Sensei 道了谢。

lines.en: : There were no additional steps between any of those three things.
lines.zh: : 这三件事之间没有任何多余的环节。

lines.en: : Uhh...there were a bunch of additional steps.
lines.zh: : 呃……多余的环节一大堆好吧。

lines.en: : But I know how much you hate looking weak so we can just pretend those other steps never happened, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不过我知道你有多讨厌显得软弱，所以我们就假装那些环节不存在好了。

lines.en: : What other steps? I have no idea what you’re referring to.
lines.zh: : 什么多余的环节？我完全不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : But that aside, do you like your present as well?
lines.zh: : 先不说这个，你喜欢你的礼物吗？

lines.en: scene green27
: I love it.
lines.zh: : 我超喜欢。

lines.en: : They’ll go perfectly with the outfits we have planned, too.
lines.zh: : 而且跟我们计划好的那套搭配起来肯定特别合适。

lines.en: : I was thinking the same thing.
lines.zh: : 我也是这么想的。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll look adorable.
lines.zh: : 我相信你穿上一定很可爱。

lines.en: : Heheh~ Of course I will.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 那当然啦。

lines.en: : You probably won’t look half-bad yourself, Maya.
lines.zh: : Maya，你自己穿上大概也不会差到哪儿去。

lines.en: : Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : Now-
lines.zh: : 那么——

lines.en: : I believe we have a few more things we still need to buy, don’t we?
lines.zh: : 我想我们还有几样东西要买，不是吗？

lines.en: scene black
I follow the two girls into a number of stores after that and watch them try on things like boots and jackets.
lines.zh: 之后我跟着两个女孩进了一家又一家店，看着她们试靴子、试外套。

lines.en: I receive a number of stares from passersby but it’s hard to discern whether or not they’re due to the fact that I’m the only male in what seems like the entire mall or just that I’m with two [teenage]girls.
lines.zh: 路人投来不少目光，不过很难分辨那究竟是因为我是这整个商场里唯一的男性，还是因为我和两个 [teenage]女孩在一起。

lines.en: Either way, the stares make me feel strange.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，那些目光让我觉得很不自在。

lines.en: Like I’m out of place.
lines.zh: 像是我不属于这里。

lines.en: But that’s just the thing.
lines.zh: 可问题就在这儿。

lines.en: I {i}am{/i} out of place.
lines.zh: 我{i}确实{/i}格格不入。

lines.en: I don’t belong here.
lines.zh: 我不属于这个地方。

lines.en: I’m just filling in for someone who does.
lines.zh: 我只是在替某个属于这里的人顶班。

lines.en: And until that person comes back to reclaim the life I’ve gone and ruined-
lines.zh: 而在那个人回来接管被我搞砸的人生之前——

lines.en: I will continue doing things to accidentally make all of the people I know cry.
lines.zh: 我会继续做着各种事，无意间让所有我认识的人哭出来。

lines.en: That’s just the way things work here.
lines.zh: 这里的事情就是这么运转的。

lines.en: scene green28
The rest of the night resembles bumper-to-bumper traffic on the highway in the middle of a snowstorm.
lines.zh: 这一晚剩下的时间，就像是暴风雪中高速公路上首尾相接的车流。

lines.en: We stop and go.
lines.zh: 我们停停走走。

lines.en: Stop and go.
lines.zh: 停停走走。

lines.en: Stop and go and stop and go and stop and go.
lines.zh: 停停走走，停停走走，停停走走。

lines.en: And it gets annoying.
lines.zh: 而这很烦人。

lines.en: Ami keeps her head up the entire time.
lines.zh: Ami 全程都抬着头。

lines.en: But I can’t help but notice Maya slipping in and out of character whenever she’s ignored for more than ten seconds at a time.
lines.zh: 可我忍不住注意到，每当 Maya 被冷落超过十秒，她就会一会儿入戏、一会儿出戏。

lines.en: It’s scary how different we become when we’re not sure how to feel.
lines.zh: 当我们不确定该作何感受时，我们会变得判若两人，这很可怕。

lines.en: And something about the way today went must have done that to her.
lines.zh: 而今天这种走向，一定对她造成了那样的影响。

lines.en: But last time was kind of like this too.
lines.zh: 不过上次也有点像这样。

lines.en: In the days leading up to my first time watching the world start over, Maya was angrier than normal.
lines.zh: 在我第一次目睹世界重来之前的那些日子里，Maya 比平时更暴躁。

lines.en: Sure, she’s always had a slightly vicious personality.
lines.zh: 当然，她的性格一向有点刻薄。

lines.en: But she’s more like a stray cat than a snake.
lines.zh: 但她更像一只流浪猫，而不是一条蛇。

lines.en: More hesitant and easily-triggered than outright evil.
lines.zh: 与其说是彻头彻尾的恶，不如说是更容易犹豫、更容易被激怒。

lines.en: Right now, the stray cat is out in full force.
lines.zh: 而现在，那只流浪猫正全力以赴。

lines.en: It hides behind an illusion that it’s bigger than it actually is. Stronger than it actually is.
lines.zh: 它躲在一种幻象后面——假装自己比实际更大，比实际更强。

lines.en: And the second something causes the cat to question that, the illusion shatters.
lines.zh: 而一旦有什么事让那只猫对此产生怀疑，幻象就会碎裂。

lines.en: So, what are we supposed to do when dealing with stray cats?
lines.zh: 那么，面对流浪猫，我们该怎么办？

lines.en: That’s simple.
lines.zh: 很简单。

lines.en: You just leave them alone.
lines.zh: 别去管它。

lines.en: You wait for the illusion to rebuild.
lines.zh: 等幻象重新建立起来。

lines.en: And pretend there was never a second where it ever went away in the first place.
lines.zh: 然后假装它从未有片刻消失过。

lines.en: scene black
scene green29
: ...and then Ayane said to the cashier that she could have her fired within minutes if she wanted to!
lines.zh: : ……然后 Ayane 对收银员说，她要是想的话，几分钟之内就能让人家被炒鱿鱼！

lines.en: : That sounds about right.
lines.zh: : 这听起来很符合她的风格。

lines.en: As I moved through the automatic doors alongside the same girl I see just seconds after waking up every morning-
lines.zh: 当我穿过自动门，身旁跟着那个每天早上醒来几秒后就会看见的女孩——

lines.en: I couldn’t help but notice that, for the first time-
lines.zh: 我忍不住注意到，这是第一次——

lines.en: I was being followed by a stray cat.
lines.zh: 我被一只流浪猫跟着。
